project_type: AWS SAM (Serverless Application Model) Python 3.12 Lambda service with API Gateway HttpApi and DynamoDB
build_system: AWS SAM CLI (sam build, sam deploy). No Makefile. No Docker build for tests.
test_framework: pytest with moto for DynamoDB mocking. Tests in tests/unit/. conftest.py provides fixtures: dynamodb_table, order_service, make_api_event helper.
build_command: python3.12 -m py_compile on all source files (AST validation - no network for pip)
test_command: pytest tests/ (requires boto3, moto, pytest installed - not available in sandbox due to network restrictions)
verification_instructions: 1. Validate Python syntax with py_compile on all modified/new .py files. 2. Validate template.yaml is well-formed YAML. 3. Review that tests are structurally correct.
setup_instructions: pip install -r requirements.txt -r requirements-dev.txt (NOT possible in this sandbox due to network restrictions)
environment_constraints: INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network mode - cannot install packages from PyPI. Python 3.12 available via pyenv but no packages installed. Use AST/syntax validation (python3.12 -m py_compile) instead of running tests. Cannot run pytest.
contribution_requirements: Follow existing handler pattern in CLAUDE.md. Keep handlers thin. Use service layer for business logic. Error responses follow {error: {code, message}} format. Use make_api_event helper in tests.
key_patterns: 1. Handlers import OrderService at module level. 2. make_api_event() in conftest.py builds HTTP API v2 proxy events with requestContext.http.method/path. 3. Response helpers: success(body, status) and error(code, message, status) in src/utils/response.py. 4. DynamoDB single-table with pk/sk and gsi1pk/gsi1sk. 5. API Gateway HTTP API v2 event format has requestContext.authorizer.jwt.claims for JWT authorizers.
directory_structure: services/order-service/ contains: template.yaml (SAM), src/ (handlers/, models/, services/, utils/), tests/ (unit/, conftest.py), events/, scripts/, docs/
